scope: One real-provider smoke; not a benchmark

response.question: Compare the ordered practice funnel.
response.summary: The ordered practice funnel shows a decrease in the signup-to-practice start rate from before to after, dropping from 84.6 % to 70.4167 %. The practice completion rate within seven days also decreased, from 56.2167 % before to 30.5 % after. Conditional completion rate, the rate of completion given practice start, declined from 66.45 % before to 43.3136 % after. The funnel analysis counts unique users and matches start and completion session identifiers in timestamp order within seven days of signup, as defined in the ordered practice funnel contract.

retrieval.title: Ordered practice funnel
retrieval.text: The funnel is signup to practice start to practice completion within seven days. Count unique users and match start/completion session identifiers in timestamp order. Report both signup-to-step and conditional completion rates.

retrieval.title: Supported analytical scope
retrieval.text: Only activation, ordered funnel and onboarding_valid/onboarding_srm experiments are defined. Segment by acquisition channel or signup device. Engagement, revenue, retention and arbitrary custom metrics are not defined; clarify or abstain.

retrieval.title: Effect uncertainty
retrieval.text: Report treatment minus control in percentage points with a 95% Newcombe score interval based on Wilson intervals. An interval crossing zero is inconclusive, not proof of no effect. Statistical significance alone does not justify shipping.

evidence.sql:
WITH starts AS (
  SELECT e.user_id, e.practice_session_id, MIN(e.event_at) AS started_at
  FROM events e JOIN users u USING(user_id)
  WHERE e.event_type='practice_start' AND e.practice_session_id <> ''
    AND e.event_at >= u.signup_at AND e.event_at < u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
  GROUP BY e.user_id, e.practice_session_id
), completions AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id FROM events e
  JOIN starts s ON e.user_id=s.user_id AND e.practice_session_id=s.practice_session_id
  JOIN users u ON e.user_id=u.user_id
  WHERE e.event_type='practice_complete' AND e.event_at >= s.started_at
    AND e.event_at < u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
), cohort AS (
  SELECT u.*, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM starts s WHERE s.user_id=u.user_id) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS started,
    CASE WHEN c.user_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS completed
  FROM users u LEFT JOIN completions c USING(user_id)
  WHERE u.signup_at >= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP) AND u.signup_at < CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
    AND u.signup_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY <= CAST(? AS TIMESTAMP)
) SELECT COUNT(*) denominator, COALESCE(SUM(started),0) started, COALESCE(SUM(completed),0) numerator FROM cohort
